blocks.text: **may** va **might** — «balki», «...ishi mumkin», «...bo'lsa ajab emas». Qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 29-dars) ularni asosan kelajak haqida ishlatgansiz: I might go out tonight. Bu darsda — **hozirgi** va **o'tmishdagi** holat haqida taxmin; kelajakdagi ehtimol, might as well va boshqa iboralar — 30-darsda. may / might — must va can't (→ 28-dars) orasidagi «o'rta»: so'zlovchi aniq bilmaydi, faqat imkoniyatni ko'radi. O'zbekchadagi «-dir» qo'shimchasi ham aynan shu ma'noni beradi: She **might be** at home — U uyda**dir**.
Hozir: may be, might be, might be -ing

Hozirgi holat haqida: **may / might + be** yoki holat fe'li (know, have, want, need), jarayon uchun — **may / might be + -ing**. **could** ham shu ma'noda ishlatiladi (→ 27-dars): He **could be** at the gym. Bu ma'noda uchalasi — may, might, could — deyarli bir xil. Odatda gapda dalil yoki sabab ham bo'ladi: nega shunday deb o'ylayapmiz?

items.text: Jasur **might be** at the gym — he usually goes after work.
items.translation: Jasur **sport zalida bo'lishi mumkin** — odatda ishdan keyin boradi.

items.text: Don't ring the bell; the baby **may be sleeping**.
Emma **might know** a good dentist near here.
items.translation: Emma bu atrofda yaxshi tish shifokorini **bilsa ajab emas**.

blocks.text: may yoki might? maybe yoki may be?

Taxmin ma'nosida may va might deyarli bir xil; might biroz kamroq ishonchni bildiradi va og'zaki nutqda ko'proq uchraydi, may — rasmiyroq. Savolda taxmin uchun odatda may ishlatilmaydi: «May he be at home?» emas → **Do you think** he's at home? yoki **Could** he be at home? May I ...? esa — ruxsat so'rash (→ 37-dars). Yana bir chalkashlik: **maybe** — bitta so'z, ravish («balki»), odatda gap boshida keladi; **may be** — ikki so'z, fe'l («bo'lishi mumkin»).
might not va can't: taxmin yoki ishonch

**might not / may not** — «balki ... emasdir», «...masligi mumkin»: bu faqat imkoniyat, ishonch yo'q. **can't** — «bo'lishi mumkin emas»: so'zlovchi ishonadi (→ 28-dars). She **might not be** at home — balki uyda emasdir; She **can't be** at home — uyda bo'lishi mumkin emas (aniq bilaman). may not qisqarmaydi («mayn't» yo'q), mightn't esa kamdan-kam ishlatiladi.

items.text: Tom **might not be** hungry; he had a big lunch.
items.translation: Tomning qorni **och bo'lmasligi mumkin**; tushlikda ko'p yedi.

items.text: Tom **can't be** hungry — he's just eaten two plates of plov!
items.translation: Tomning qorni och **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — hozirgina ikki likopcha palov yedi!

blocks.text: O'tmish: may have done / might have done

O'tmish haqida taxmin: **may / might have + V3** — «-gan bo'lishi mumkin», «-gandir»: He **might have missed** the train — Poyezddan qolgan bo'lishi mumkin. Jarayon uchun — **might have been + -ing**. **could have** ham shu ma'noda ishlatiladi: She **could have taken** a taxi. Inkorga e'tibor bering: **might not have** — «balki ...magandir» (imkoniyat), **couldn't have** — «...gan bo'lishi mumkin emas» (ishonch).

rows: She **might not have seen** you. (balki ko'rmagandir)
She **couldn't have seen** you. (ko'rgan bo'lishi mumkin emas)
He **might not have got** the message.
He **couldn't have got** the message — I never sent it.

items.text: Kate **may have gone** home already — her coat isn't here.
items.translation: Keyt allaqachon uyga **ketgan bo'lishi mumkin** — paltosi bu yerda yo'q.

items.text: I **might have made** a mistake in the calculation.
They **might not have heard** the news yet.

blocks.text: **might have + V3** ba'zan «bo'lishi mumkin edi, lekin bo'lmadi» ma'nosida ham keladi (could have kabi, → 27-dars): Be careful — you **might have fallen**! Ta'na ohangida ham: You **might have told** me! — Aytsang bo'lardi-ku!

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «She maybe ill» → She **may be** ill yoki **Maybe** she is ill; «He may went» → he **may have gone**; «May he be at home?» → **Do you think** he's at home?; «She might not be home» bilan «She can't be home» ni bir xil deb o'ylash — birinchisi taxmin, ikkinchisi ishonch; «mayn't» → **may not**.

Ishonch shkalasi: **must** (aniq ha) → **may / might / could** (balki) → **might not / may not** (balki yo'q) → **can't / couldn't** (aniq yo'q). O'zbekchadagi «-dir» ni eslang: «uyda**dir**» = might be at home, «ketgan**dir**» = might have gone.

examples.title: Maybe true now: **may be** / **might be**
examples.description: Hozirgi holat haqida taxmin — may / might + be yoki holat fe'li. O'zbekcha «...ishi mumkin», «-dir».

sentences.text: Madina isn't answering her phone. She **might be** in a meeting.
sentences.translation: Madina telefonini ko'tarmayapti. **Yig'ilishda bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: This mushroom **may be** poisonous, so don't eat it.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'ziqorin **zaharli bo'lishi mumkin**, uni yemang.

sentences.text: I'm not sure where Tom is. He **might be** at the library.
sentences.translation: Tom qayerdaligini bilmayman. **Kutubxonada bo'lsa ajab emas**.

sentences.text: The answer **may be** in the second chapter of the textbook.
sentences.translation: Javob darslikning ikkinchi bobida **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Ask Jasur about the job. He **might know** someone at that company.
sentences.translation: Ish haqida Jasurdan so'ra. U o'sha kompaniyada birortasini **tanishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: There's a strange noise in the engine; it **might be** something serious.
sentences.translation: Dvigatelda g'alati shovqin bor; jiddiy biror narsa **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Don't laugh at him — he **may have** a good reason for being late.
sentences.translation: Uning ustidan kulmang — kechikkani uchun jiddiy sababi **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Sarah looks pale; she **might feel** ill but not want to say so.
sentences.translation: Sara oqarib ketgan; o'zini yomon **his qilayotgandir**, lekin aytishni xohlamayapti.

sentences.text: According to some experts, the painting **may be** worth millions.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi mutaxassislarga ko'ra, rasm millionlab dollar **turishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Your keys **might be** in the car — have you checked there?
sentences.translation: Kalitlaring **mashinada bo'lishi mumkin** — u yerni tekshirdingmi?

examples.title: In progress now: **might be doing**
examples.description: Hozir davom etayotgan jarayon haqida taxmin — may / might be + -ing: «-ayotgan bo'lishi mumkin», «-ayotgandir».

sentences.text: Don't call Aziz now; he **might be driving**.
sentences.translation: Hozir Azizga qo'ng'iroq qilma; **mashina haydayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Kate **may be working** from home today — her car is still outside.
sentences.translation: Keyt bugun uydan **ishlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin** — mashinasi hali tashqarida.

sentences.text: Where are the children? — They **might be playing** in the park.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qayerda? — Bog'da **o'ynayotgandir**.

sentences.text: James **might be waiting** for us at the wrong entrance.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bizni noto'g'ri kirishda **kutayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I can't hear the TV; Grandpa **may be sleeping** in his chair.
sentences.translation: Televizor ovozi eshitilmayapti; bobom kreslosida **uxlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The website is very slow — thousands of people **might be trying** to buy tickets.
sentences.translation: Sayt juda sekin ishlayapti — minglab odamlar chipta olishga **urinayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Nilufar hasn't replied; she **might be studying** for her exam.
sentences.translation: Nilufar javob bermadi; imtihonga **tayyorlanayotgandir**.

sentences.text: Oliver **may not be telling** us the whole truth about the accident.
sentences.translation: Oliver bizga avariya haqida butun haqiqatni **aytmayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Those men **might be repairing** the gas pipe — that's why the road is closed.
sentences.translation: Anavi kishilar gaz quvurini **ta'mirlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin** — shuning uchun yo'l yopiq.

sentences.text: Is Dilnoza still in the office? — She **might be packing** up right now.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza hali ofisdami? — Hozir narsalarini **yig'ishtirayotgandir**.

examples.title: **might not** or **can't**? Maybe not or surely not
examples.description: Juft-juft: might not / may not — «balki ... emasdir» (taxmin); can't — «bo'lishi mumkin emas» (ishonch).

sentences.text: Bekzod **might not be** at home; his lights are off.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **uyda bo'lmasligi mumkin**; chiroqlari o'chiq.

sentences.text: Bekzod **can't be** at home — he's just called me from the airport.
sentences.translation: Bekzod uyda **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — hozirgina aeroportdan qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: The restaurant **may not have** any free tables on a Friday night.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni kechqurun restoranda bo'sh stol **bo'lmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: This **may not be** the best time to ask for a pay rise.
sentences.translation: Bu maosh oshirishni so'rash uchun eng yaxshi **payt emasdir**.

sentences.text: I **might not understand** everything, but I'll try my best.
sentences.translation: Hammasini **tushunmasligim mumkin**, lekin qo'limdan kelganini qilaman.

sentences.text: That story **can't be** true — there's no such street in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Bu hikoya **rost bo'lishi mumkin emas** — Oksfordda bunday ko'cha yo'q.

sentences.text: That story **might not be** true, so let's check it first.
sentences.translation: Bu hikoya **rost bo'lmasligi mumkin**, keling, avval tekshiraylik.

sentences.text: Emma **may not know** that the meeting has moved to Thursday.
sentences.translation: Emma yig'ilish payshanbaga ko'chganini **bilmasligi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The price **can't be** right — nobody sells a new laptop for fifty pounds.
sentences.translation: Narx **to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin emas** — hech kim yangi noutbukni ellik funtga sotmaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah **might not want** to come, because her ex-husband will be there.
sentences.translation: Sara **kelishni xohlamasligi mumkin**, chunki sobiq eri o'sha yerda bo'ladi.

examples.title: **could be**, **maybe** and **may be**
examples.description: could be = might be (taxmin). maybe — ravish, «balki»; may be — fe'l, «bo'lishi mumkin»: ma'no bir, tuzilish boshqa.

sentences.text: **Maybe** the shop is closed today, because the lights are off.
sentences.translation: **Balki** do'kon bugun yopiqdir, chiroqlari o'chiq.

sentences.text: The shop **may be** closed today because of the holiday.
sentences.translation: Bayram munosabati bilan do'kon bugun **yopiq bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Where's my phone? — It **could be** under the sofa cushions.
sentences.translation: Telefonim qayerda? — Divan yostiqlari ostida **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: **Maybe** we should leave now, before the traffic gets worse.
sentences.translation: **Balki** tirbandlik kuchaymasdan hozir chiqib ketishimiz kerakdir.

sentences.text: That **could be** the reason why sales have fallen.
sentences.translation: Savdo kamayganining sababi shu **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The noise **may be** coming from the flat upstairs.
sentences.translation: Shovqin yuqoridagi kvartiradan **kelayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: **Maybe** Dilnoza forgot about the meeting — she's usually very punctual.
sentences.translation: **Balki** Dilnoza yig'ilishni unutgandir — u odatda juda vaqtga rioya qiladi.

sentences.text: Kate's not answering; she **could be** on the underground.
sentences.translation: Keyt javob bermayapti; **metroda bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: It **might be** better to take the train than to drive in this weather.
sentences.translation: Bu ob-havoda mashina haydagandan ko'ra poyezdda borish **yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Your headaches **could be** a sign that you need glasses.
sentences.translation: Bosh og'rig'ingiz ko'zoynak kerakligining **belgisi bo'lishi mumkin**.

examples.title: About the past: **may have done** / **might have done**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi voqea haqida taxmin — may / might have + V3: «-gan bo'lishi mumkin», «-gandir».

sentences.text: Aziz is late. He **might have missed** the bus.
sentences.translation: Aziz kechikyapti. Avtobusdan **qolib ketgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I can't find my umbrella; I **may have left** it on the train.
sentences.translation: Soyabonimni topa olmayapman; uni poyezdda **qoldirgan bo'lishim mumkin**.

sentences.text: Emma hasn't replied. She **might not have seen** my message yet.
sentences.translation: Emma javob bermadi. Xabarimni hali **ko'rmagan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The ancient city of Afrosiab **may have had** over fifty thousand inhabitants.
sentences.translation: Qadimiy Afrosiyob shahrida ellik mingdan ortiq aholi **bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Why didn't Sarah come? — She **might have been** too busy at work.
sentences.translation: Sara nega kelmadi? — Ishda juda **band bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The police think the burglars **may have entered** through the back door.
sentences.translation: Politsiya o'g'rilar orqa eshikdan **kirgan bo'lishi mumkin**, deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: Jasur looked worried; he **might have had** bad news from home.
sentences.translation: Jasur xavotirda ko'rinardi; uyidan yomon xabar **olgan bo'lsa ajab emas**.

sentences.text: Tom **may not have understood** the instructions, so let's explain again.
sentences.translation: Tom ko'rsatmalarni **tushunmagan bo'lishi mumkin**, keling, yana tushuntiraylik.

sentences.text: You **might have dropped** your ticket when you took out your wallet.
sentences.translation: Hamyoningni olganingda chiptangni **tushirib qo'ygan bo'lishing mumkin**.

sentences.text: The fire **may have started** in the kitchen, but nobody knows for sure.
sentences.translation: Yong'in oshxonadan **boshlangan bo'lishi mumkin**, lekin hech kim aniq bilmaydi.

examples.title: **might have been doing**, **could have been**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi jarayon haqida taxmin — might have been + -ing; could have ham «-gan bo'lishi mumkin» ma'nosida.

sentences.text: Madina didn't hear the phone; she **might have been sleeping**.
sentences.translation: Madina telefonni eshitmadi; **uxlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The driver **may have been using** his phone when the accident happened.
sentences.translation: Avariya sodir bo'lganda haydovchi telefonidan **foydalanayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Where was Bekzod at midnight? — He **could have been** at his brother's.
sentences.translation: Yarim tunda Bekzod qayerda edi? — Akasinikida **bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The documents **could have got** lost in the post.
sentences.translation: Hujjatlar pochtada **yo'qolib qolgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Kate was smiling at the screen; she **might have been chatting** with her boyfriend.
sentences.translation: Keyt ekranga qarab jilmayib o'tirardi; yigiti bilan **yozishayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: I'm not sure who called. It **could have been** the bank, or maybe the dentist.
sentences.translation: Kim qo'ng'iroq qilganini bilmayman. Bank **bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin**, yoki tish shifokori.

sentences.text: Oliver **may have been joking** when he said he was leaving the company.
sentences.translation: Oliver kompaniyadan ketaman deganda **hazillashayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: The pilot **might have been trying** to avoid the storm.
sentences.translation: Uchuvchi bo'rondan **qochishga urinayotgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We **could have taken** the wrong turning — this doesn't look like Fergana.
sentences.translation: Biz noto'g'ri yo'lga **burilgan bo'lishimiz mumkin** — bu Farg'onaga o'xshamaydi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **might have been waiting** for hours before anyone noticed her.
sentences.translation: Kimdir uni sezgunicha Nilufar soatlab **kutib turgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

examples.title: **might not have** or **couldn't have**? **may** or **must**?
examples.description: Juft-juft: taxmin (may / might have, might not have) va ishonch (must have, can't / couldn't have).

sentences.text: Aziz **might not have got** my email — I'll send it again.
sentences.translation: Aziz xatimni **olmagan bo'lishi mumkin** — yana yuboraman.

sentences.text: Aziz **couldn't have got** my email; I sent it to the wrong address!
sentences.translation: Aziz xatimni **olgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; uni noto'g'ri manzilga jo'natibman!

sentences.text: Kate **might not have known** about the party, so don't be angry with her.
sentences.translation: Keyt ziyofat haqida **bilmagan bo'lishi mumkin**, shuning uchun undan xafa bo'lma.

sentences.text: Kate **couldn't have known** about the party — it was a complete secret.
sentences.translation: Keyt ziyofat haqida **bilgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — bu to'liq sir edi.

sentences.text: The burglar **must have had** a key, because the lock wasn't damaged.
sentences.translation: O'g'rida kalit **bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak**, chunki qulfga shikast yetmagan.

sentences.text: The burglar **may have had** a key, or he **might have climbed** in through the window.
sentences.translation: O'g'rida kalit **bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin**, yoki u derazadan **kirgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: You **can't have lost** your passport — I saw it in your bag five minutes ago.
sentences.translation: Pasportingni **yo'qotgan bo'lishing mumkin emas** — besh daqiqa oldin sumkangda ko'rdim.

sentences.text: You **might have lost** your passport at the airport; let's call lost property.
sentences.translation: Pasportingni aeroportda **yo'qotgan bo'lishing mumkin**; yo'qolgan buyumlar bo'limiga qo'ng'iroq qilaylik.

sentences.text: Jasur **must have forgotten** our meeting — he's never late.
sentences.translation: Jasur uchrashuvimizni **unutgan bo'lsa kerak** — u hech qachon kechikmaydi.

sentences.text: Jasur **may have forgotten** our meeting, or he **might** just **be** stuck in traffic.
sentences.translation: Jasur uchrashuvimizni **unutgan bo'lishi mumkin**, yoki shunchaki tirbandlikda **qolgandir**.

examples.title: Dialogue: where is Grandpa?
examples.description: Oila a'zolari bobolari qayerda ekanini taxmin qilishadi: might be, can't be, may have gone, must have taken.

sentences.text: — Grandpa isn't answering his phone. Where **might** he **be**?
sentences.translation: — Bobom telefonini ko'tarmayapti. Qayerda **bo'lishi mumkin**?

sentences.text: — He **might be** at the teahouse with his friends, as usual.
sentences.translation: — Odatdagidek, do'stlari bilan choyxonada **bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — No, the teahouse is closed on Mondays. He **can't be** there.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, choyxona dushanba kunlari yopiq. U yerda **bo'lishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: — Then he **may have gone** to the bazaar to buy melons.
sentences.translation: — Unda qovun olgani bozorga **ketgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — Maybe, but he **might have forgotten** his phone at home again.
sentences.translation: — Balki, lekin u telefonini yana uyda **unutib qoldirgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — No, his phone isn't here. He **must have taken** it with him.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, telefoni bu yerda yo'q. Uni o'zi bilan **olib ketgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: — He **might not have heard** it ring — the bazaar is so noisy.
sentences.translation: — Jiringlaganini **eshitmagan bo'lishi mumkin** — bozor juda shovqinli.

sentences.text: — True. Or he **could be** sitting on a bench in the park.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Yoki bog'da o'rindiqda **o'tirgan bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: — Look, there's a message from him: he **may be** back late!
sentences.translation: — Qara, undan xabar keldi: kech **qaytishi mumkin** ekan!

sentences.text: — Typical! He **might have told** us earlier, but at least he's fine.
sentences.translation: — Doim shunaqa! Oldinroq **aytsa bo'lardi**, lekin hech bo'lmasa u yaxshi.
